rules: business-specific state names map into system semantics instead of creating global status colors
color is never the only state signal
neutral uses normal surface/text semantics instead of inventing a sixth status family
ranking, level, stage and category are not automatically status semantics
base status chroma is a marker semantic, not a guaranteed foreground on every background
on a tinted status background, text and necessary status graphics use the corresponding *Text semantic unless a different pairing is separately contrast-audited
on an inverse transient-feedback surface, status meaning may be carried by icon shape plus message while the icon uses the inverse foreground semantic
no-results is contextual to the current query and is not the whole-product empty state
preserve query on recoverable request failure
preserve usable previous results during background refresh when possible
query-match emphasis cannot rely on color alone
avoid major layout jumps on each keystroke
